captions.detailed: A folding pedestrian barrier system consisting of a dark grey wall-anchor bracket and three yellow rectangular panel sections linked in a chain. Each panel features a yellow frame with two black horizontal slotted ventilation grates. The sections are connected via vertical cylindrical hinges, allowing the entire assembly to fold flat against the wall bracket or extend outward in a Z-fold configuration.
captions.instruction: Generate a folding pedestrian barrier in CadQuery. It should feature a wall-mounting bracket, three yellow-framed rectangular panels with black slotted grates, and revolute joints connecting the bracket to the first panel, and subsequent panels to each other to allow Z-folding articulation.
captions.factory: Construct a dark grey wall bracket using a Box primitive. Build three identical yellow frames by combining thin vertical and horizontal Box shapes. Create black slotted grates by patterning rectangular slots on a thin Box, and embed two of these into each yellow frame. Connect the components using cylindrical hinges, and define revolute articulations at each hinge axis to allow folding.
